name: Pacificon
blurb: A tabletop and board-game expo at the Santa Clara Marriott, run by PacifiConQuest alongside a prototype playtesting track called Pacificon Protospiel.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Pacificon Game Expo RuggieroCon - Pacificon Protospiel September 3-6, 2027 Santa Clara Marriott Hotel 2700 Mission College Blvd, Santa Clara, CA 95054'.

notes: PacifiConQuest (the organizer/site) runs several separately branded grassroots tabletop gatherings — Barnstorm at a vineyard, South Pacificon Game Fest Winter and ConQuest Channel Islands at masonic lodges, and this Pacificon Game Expo — so this file covers only the Santa Clara Pacificon Game Expo / Protospiel edition per the batch id, not the others. The site is a Google Sites page with no crawlable nav links, no og/twitter image, no logo and no mention anywhere of a celebrity-guest program, so guests is 'none' rather than 'none-yet'; the cover uses the largest available photo on the page. No ticket link was found.
